name: card-resize
description: A transitions.dev-inspired card resize primitive that expands a compact card into a detail panel

vars.description: Card colour scheme: paper is the original white card, ink is a dark card for dark frames.
Treatment of the media thumbnail: a plain plate, a hatched surface, or an image plate with a horizon-and-disc glyph.
How far the card lifts off the frame, from a contact shadow to a deep drop.
